cases.title: Preserving unsent work across document revisions
cases.before_counterexample: serialize, reload, pull and save cannot overwrite a newer remote edit
cases.regression_counterexample: serialize, reload, pull and save cannot overwrite a newer remote edit

cases.title: Reading back every promised upload copy
cases.before_counterexample: a 9.55 MB original has all three complete readbacks despite an oversized aggregate envelope
cases.regression_counterexample: an acknowledged but truncated copy cannot produce a complete-redundancy receipt

cases.title: Bounding escalation when session discovery fails
cases.before_counterexample: eight drains cannot launch more than three unidentified sessions; undelivered work stays visible
cases.regression_counterexample: an unavailable inventory is not an empty inventory and cannot authorize a launch
